com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Replace one invoice's review notes with your chosen text. Shows the previous notes so you can review what will be overwritten. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: Preview replacing the selected invoice's review notes with: Waiting for supplier to confirm the delivery date. Show the existing notes and wait for my confirmation.
Preview clearing the selected invoice's review notes by replacing them with empty text. Show what will be removed and wait for my confirmation.

description: Prepare replacement of an invoice's review notes with the exact supplied text. Show existing notes and require confirmation before saving. This returns an exact preview and a five-minute confirmation token; it does not apply the change.
name: preview_update_invoice_notes
title: Preview: Update review notes
